|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">「……乗員をわしのもとにつれて来い。生きたままでだ！」帝国軍の兵士たちは、捕虜を生け捕って尋問する必要がある場合、ブラスターをスタン（気絶）・モードにセットする。</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Shoot in Stun Mode.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to choose one opposing character as a target. Draw destiny. If the destiny is greater than the character's ability, that character immediately returns to the opponent's hand. All cards deployed on that character also return to hand.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Lore:''' "...Bring the crew to me. Alive!" Imperial soldiers set their blasters to stun (unconsciousness) mode when they need to capture prisoners alive for interrogation.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese parenthetical says that the attached cards return to hand without specifying whose hands; the printed English expressly says owners' hands. The Japanese lore refers to the crew rather than the English passengers and omits the English reference to using the stun setting for intimidation.<ref name="jp1-face" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-setforstun.gif|Set For Stun original English printed face]].</ref>
